Dual-device connection (off by default, enable in Xiaomi Earbuds app)
Case 61 x 50 x 24.6 mm, 31.4 g; earbud 54 mAh, case 480 mAh

bluetooth.notes: Xiaomi's official FAQ writes the name as "REDMI Buds 5" (newer brand styling); the printed manual illustration and reviews show "Redmi Buds 5", so match case-insensitively. Must NOT match "Redmi Buds 5 Pro" / "Redmi Buds 5A" / "Redmi Buds 5C" (the anchored regex excludes them). Pairing PIN if asked: 0000. Fast Pair pop-up appears on Android when the lid is opened near the phone; Fast Pair is disabled for 5 minutes after being dismissed 3 times. Fast Pair model ID and BLE manufacturer data not published.

pairingSteps: Put both earbuds in the charging case and close the lid.

Open the lid near the phone. On first use (or after unpairing) the case's white light blinks for about 1 minute and the earbuds wait for a connection; on Android a Google Fast Pair pop-up may appear - tap Connect.
If the light is not blinking, keep the lid open and press and hold the function button on the back of the case for about 2 seconds until the white light blinks.
On the phone open Settings > Bluetooth, turn it on, and tap "Redmi Buds 5" in the list. Enter 0000 if a PIN is requested.
To reset: with the earbuds in the case and the lid open, press and hold the case button for about 10 seconds until the light flashes; then pair again.
